description:
Ah-reum possesses an innocent appearance, but deep down, she has a lewder mind than anyone else. It's an everyday routine for her to go to work and think about sex instead of doing her job. Well, what can she do? Just looking at Team Leader Ryu Ji-hyuk turns her on. That day too, as always, she was conjuring up all sorts of fantasies in her head with Team Leader Ryu Ji-hyuk right in front of her. But...

"Is it really that important to know where it's stored?"  
"Pardon?"  
"Every time you look at me, you check whether my dick leans to the left or the right first."

Team Leader Ryu Ji-hyuk... seems to know all of Ah-reum's innermost thoughts?!

"Ngh, what are you doing right now...?"  
"You said you wanted me to fuck you like a dog right here at your desk, didn't you? So I'm going to fuck you."

Ever since that day, Ji-hyuk starts making every single one of the fantasies Ah-reum only kept in her head come true...
